Definition: Jehojada, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jehoiada = "Jehovah knows"; 1) father of Benaiah, David's mighty warrior; 2) leader of the priests who joined David at Hebron; 3) high priest at the time of Athaliah's usurpation of the throne of Judah; hid Joash, the king's son, for six years and eventually replaced him on the throne of Judah; 4) second priest, or sagan, to Seraiah the high priest
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
